Hi <data_privacy_customer_full_name>,   

 
Thank you for submitting your data privacy "Data Deletion" request associated with Reference ID: <request_id> . Your concerns are of paramount importance to us, and we appreciate your proactive stance towards safeguarding your personal information.

Following a comprehensive review of your request and in alignment with our commitment to data integrity and security, we regret to inform you that we are unable to fulfill your current request. The decision stems from the presence of your information within one or more of the following categories:

(1) required to complete a transaction that you requested or part of our ongoing business relationship with you;  
(2) required to comply with a legal obligation; 
(3) required to prevent and/or detect cybersecurity incidents and fraud; or
(4) required for internal purposes as permitted by applicable law.

We want to underscore that the retained information will be used exclusively for the purposes elucidated above.
For any further queries, feel free to reach out to us.


Thanks,
